incident-bot: SEV2 - customer streaming failures detected for tenant helixbank (vpc-dedicated-03). Alert: websocket disconnect spike + 502 gateway responses. Paging SRE rota: @Alex (oncall)
Erin D: Paging SRE — HelixBank reporting repeated websocket timeouts from their app gateway. We see a sharp increase in ws handshake p95 and 502s from the enterprise gateway between 03:12-03:28 UTC. Customer-facing sessions dropped.
Alex (oncall): I’m on it. Can you paste the first error window and any correlation ids?
Erin D: Logs below (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T03:14:05Z helixbank-conn-req id=cb8f2 ws_handshake=timed_out backend_resp=502 gateway_retry=3
2026-03-15T03:14:06Z helixbank-stream id=cb8f2 chunk_err=broken_pipe client_retry=5
2026-03-15T03:16:30Z helixbank-conn-req id=dd12a ws_handshake=200 latency_ms=1800
```
Erin D: Observations: (1) many client retries from their appgw, (2) ws handshake latency spikes ~1.5-2s p95 (normal ~120ms), (3) all traffic pinned to dedicated pool vpc-dedicated-03.
Kaleb R: Noticed increased evictions on the dedicated pool host group around same time — kernel-level page faults + frequent restart of the infra-keeper process on node gpu-12. CPU spiking then OOM killer churned a few helper processes.
Julia P: Is tenant isolation working? If HelixBank's retries are hammering the pool, other tenants on that pool could be impacted.
Erin D: HelixBank is the only tenant on vpc-dedicated-03 per routing table — it’s a single-tenant VPC.
Alex (oncall): OK. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle incoming connections from the customer's app gateway at the ingress LB (add soft qps limit), 2) modify routing to fallback to their dedicated backup variant (helixbank-standby-pool) if available, 3) disable gateway-side automatic retries via Temp config push (suggest 0 retries) while we stabilize. Who can coordinate the config push?
eng-runtime-sre: I can push the routing override and set the retry header rewrite. Suggest adding a 20s ws handshake timeout on the gateway ingress to reduce retry storms and avoid connection pile-up.
Sam M (AM): I'll notify the HelixBank SRE/PM we are paged and initiating live mitigation. Asking them to stop client retries while we do the change so we don't flip-flop. Also checking if they have a fallback to HTTP polling.
Alex (oncall): Do we have enough capacity in standby pools for an emergency reroute? If not we need to enable graceful degradation (lower concurrency per connection).
Kaleb R: Standby pool helixbank-standby-pool currently at 40% spare. We can route 50% of new connections there and keep 50% for older sessions to avoid mass reconnections.
Erin D: Applying routing override now — switching 30% new connection traffic to standby pool + injecting header to suppress client retries. Will post command and diff.
```
# runtimectl route override
set route tenant=helixbank new_conn_split=30 standby=helixbank-standby-pool suppress_client_retries=true
```
Erin D: Done. 03:21 UTC — override active. Observability: ws handshake p95 dropped from 1800ms -> 420ms over 5 mins, 502s reduced.
Alex (oncall): Nice. Sam, can HelixBank stop client retries while we continue to monitor?
Sam M (AM): Confirmed. Customer SRE (via PM) acked and paused retries at 03:23 UTC. They also provisioned a temporary HTTP fallback for long polls.
Julia P: Can we schedule a minimal draining window to restart gpu-12 after traffic reduces? Kernel churn still concerning.
Kaleb R: Agree — plan a rolling restart of infra-keeper on gpu-12 in 30 mins with live traffic diverted to standby to avoid session loss. I'll own the restart.
eng-runtime-sre: I'll keep watch on KV cache hit rates and prefix eviction; if eviction spikes again we should enable prefix cache bypass for HelixBank for short window.
Alex (oncall): Monitoring 03:30-03:55 window. If metrics remain stable, I'll de-escalate to low ticket. Also opening a postmortem and assigning actions to eng-runtime, infra and account teams.
Erin D: Follow-up notes: root cause appears to be a combination of infra helper churn on gpu-12 causing increased handshake latency, which triggered appgw retries and retry storms. Immediate mitigations: routing override, suppress client retries, split to standby pool, coord with customer to pause retries, plan rolling restart.
Sam M (AM): Sending a customer update: "We've applied traffic shaping and temporary reroute; continuing to monitor; will follow up with postmortem and remediation timeline."
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> monitoring. Sev2 -> owner Alex (oncall). Postmortem required.
Alex (oncall): Closing the active page. Thanks everyone — I'll keep the thread open for postmortem edits. :thumbsup:
